entities.summary: Miguel Elias Rojas Naidenoff is a Venezuelan professional baseball infielder for the Los Angeles Dodgers of Major League Baseball (MLB). He has also played in MLB for the Miami Marlins. In 2025, he became the first player in MLB history to hit a game-tying home run in the 9th inning or later of a World Series Game 7.
